chunks: He said: Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Abhari reported to me, saying: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn al-Sabbah narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Abdullah, the nephew of Abd al-Razzaq, narrated to us, saying: My uncle Abd al-Razzaq ibn Hammam ibn Nafi narrated to me, saying: My father Hammam ibn Nafi informed me, saying: Meena, the client of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf al-Zuhri, informed me, saying: Abd al-Rahman said to me:

"O Meena, shall I not relate to you a hadith I heard from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family?" I said: "Yes." He said: "I heard him say: I am a tree, and Fatimah is its branch, and Ali is its fecundator, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn are its fruits, and those who love them from my Ummah are its leaves.
May God be pleased with them all. And may God bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet, and his family and grant them peace.

key_terms.ثمرة: Fruit - al-Hasan and al-Husayn as the blessed outcome of this lineage
key_terms.شجرة: Tree - metaphor for the Prophet as the origin of the holy household
key_terms.لقاح: Fecundation - Ali as the one who gives the tree its fruit-bearing capacity
key_terms.ورق: Leaves - believers who love the Ahlulbayt

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the tree of his family (Ahlulbayt)?
ai.summary: In this prophetic tradition narrated through an extended chain of transmission, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) uses the metaphor of a tree to describe his holy household. He identifies himself as the tree, his daughter Fatimah as its branch, his son-in-law Ali as the one who makes it fruitful, and his grandsons al-Hasan and al-Husayn as the fruits. The believers who love the Ahlulbayt are likened to the leaves. This hadith was narrated by the companion Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf through his freed slave Meena.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 5. He said: Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Abhari reported to me from ‘Ali ibn Ahmad al-Sabah, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Abdullah ibn Abd al-Razaq, who reported from his uncle Abd al-Razaq ibn Hammam ibn Nafe, who reported from Hammam ibn Nafe, who reported from Meena, the client of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf al-Zohari, who reported from Abd al-Rahman who said:

"O Meena, May I not relate to you what I heard from the messenger of Allah?" I said: "Yes." He said: "I heard him say: I am the tree, and Fatimah is its branch. ‘Ali fecundates it, and al-Hasan and al-Husayn are its fruits. And those of my Ummah who love them are the leaves of the tree. (May Allah shower them all with His pleasure)."
And may Allah bless out master Muhammad, the Prophet and his progeny.
